intent: WP-0F1 (TIT-006, TIT-007): CI Truth authority hardening within agent scope. Reject duplicate JSON keys at every object level before decoding can erase evidence (scripts/runtime/ci_truth.py load_json), replace the phantom 'make frontend-check' repro command with the real dashboard CI command chain (docs/governance/CI_TRUTH_CONTRACT.json), and pin both with contract tests including a resolution test over every local_command. Final required-set ratification and continuously authenticated live parity remain operator-gated (BLOCKED_OPERATOR) and are not decided here.

negative_controls.name: duplicate-key-tolerance-restored-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p = pathlib.Path('scripts/runtime/ci_truth.py'); t = p.read_text(); anchor = '            object_pairs_hook=_reject_duplicate_keys,\n'; (anchor in t) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(anchor, '', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/test_ci_truth.py', '-q']).returncode)"

negative_controls.name: phantom-command-reintroduced-detected
negative_controls.command: python3 -c "import pathlib, subprocess, sys; p = pathlib.Path('docs/governance/CI_TRUTH_CONTRACT.json'); t = p.read_text(); anchor = 'npm --prefix dashboard ci --legacy-peer-deps'; (t.count(anchor) == 1) or sys.exit(3); p.write_text(t.replace(anchor, 'make frontend-check', 1)); sys.exit(subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-m', 'pytest', 'tests/test_ci_truth.py', '-q']).returncode)"

commit.message: feat(ci): WP-0F1 CI Truth duplicate-key rejection and real repro commands (TIT-006/TIT-007)

interface_mismatches: INTERFACE_MISMATCH_MAP.md carries no open entry for the ci_truth/parity surfaces at base 1e806bd.
honest_blockers: WP-0F1 closure remains BLOCKED_OPERATOR on two spec prerequisites that no agent may decide: ratification of the final required-check set (two candidates enumerated in the spec) and bounded Administration-read access for continuously authenticated live parity (check_ci_parity.py --live reports 'no protection source' on this credential-less host). This packet lands only the agent-scope items: duplicate-key rejection, phantom-command repair, and their contract tests.

Makefile and .github/workflows/ci-parity.yml are in the spec's WP-0F1 allowed files but are deliberately untouched: no in-scope change required them, and leaving them out avoids a rebase collision with open PR #1027 (WP-0B, Makefile).
Packet pytest gates run under the runner-admitted system python3 with repo deps importable via the system dist-packages editable install performed this session.
make test-fast on this host fails only on the known tests/conformance/test_repo_ratchet_holds.py 10s-timeout flake; per-occurrence re-proof is recorded in the PR body.

The /usr/bin/make path in the macOS-compatibility entry is intentional (Apple's system make 3.81, the exact interpreter that check exercises, pinned by tests/test_onboarding_ci_contract.py); an initial normalization of it was reverted after that owning contract failed in CI, and the resolution test encodes it as the one sanctioned absolute-path exception.
session_entry.rollback: Revert scripts/runtime/ci_truth.py, docs/governance/CI_TRUTH_CONTRACT.json, tests/test_ci_truth.py, and the packet JSON together; rollback restores the prior duplicate-tolerant loader and must never be partial (the contract tests and loader move as one).
